verdict.rationale: Column documents a full API sandbox where every route is sandboxed and data persists like production. It provides `/simulate/*` endpoints for incoming wires and ACH, and API keys are fixed to sandbox or live mode at creation, so sandbox keys cannot touch production. A community comment about the separate Sandbox status page independently confirms the sandbox is a distinct environment. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of testing workflows in the sandbox (e.g., parity or simulation coverage for cards, checks and RTP).
